decisions.reason: As a strategic automation product closely aligned with the firm's core integrated precast offering, it is likely to be retained while management allows time for market learning and customer uptake.

Although it may overlap partly with the combined robot portfolio, the firm is likely to keep it because different customers need different automation steps and early underperformance would be tolerated in a growing industry.
This more specialized storage robot faces somewhat greater uncertainty in demand, but the firm's broad range, R&D orientation, and organisational slack make near-term withdrawal unlikely.

Like the automatic de-shuttering robot, it likely serves a distinct use case within tailored plant solutions, so management would probably keep it on the market unless results clearly fell below aspirations.
